en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a public square and garden framed by tall mountains. In the foreground is a large circular plaza with a monumental statue at its center, surrounded by paths and trees. In the background are several towers and historic buildings of a town nestled at the base of the mountains. The caption printed at the top identifies the scene as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.
